newsitem.title: DUBAI: Oman shares end higher, bank shares dominate.
newsitem.headline: Oman shares end higher, bank shares dominate.

text.p: Oman's stock exchange ended the week to Wednesday 1.4 percent higher in busier trade, with interest focused on bank and investment shares, the Muscat Securities Market said.
The MSM index closed at 186.53 points from 183.93.
Of the 59 companies traded in the week, shares of 30 rose, 16 fell, and 13 were unchanged, the exchange said.
A total of 2.5 million shares changed hands in 944 deals -- 58 percent more than last week.
Bank and investment company sectors accounted for 55 percent of total trading value of 4.87 million rials ($12.8 million) from 2.57 million rials the previous week.
Oman International Bank closed firmer, at 2.700 rials from 2.600 last week and United Power Company ended at 1.750 rials from a previous 1.690 rials.
